tension: Consumers are seeking immersive and interactive experiences when engaging with digital-first brands, and they want to discover and trial new products in a physical setting. This need for experiential retail is driving the growth of infrastructure that can support offline discovery and trial for these brands.
why_now: The recent expansion of Broadway to Mumbai with its largest experiential retail store, along with its ambitious revenue targets, indicates a significant opportunity for growth in this space. As consumers increasingly crave unique experiences, brands that can provide them will be well-positioned for success.
